rationale: Price sits at 3.9% of the daily range after printing five consecutive lower-low, lower-high 1-minute candles that have carried it well below both session VWAP (24.53) and the 9-EMA on 5-minute bars (24.45). Volume expands on each leg lower and spikes to 335k shares on the most recent candle that reached a fresh low of 23.83, confirming aggressive selling while SPY rallies 1.95% and VIXY collapses nearly 10%.
